data.argument: The headline growth is less reassuring than it looks: earnings and EBITDA merely match the supplied model, and there is no forecast here to establish an upside surprise. Water revenue and deliveries jumped, but the reported data do not quantify oil-and-gas contribution or show whether this demand persists. Land-development revenue also makes up a material part of the quarter, tying results to project execution and lot absorption. Cash fell to $8.44 million from $21.93 million, warranting scrutiny of funding needs as Phase 2E construction proceeds. Phase 2D timing, rental occupancy, and key demand kill criteria remain untested. This is a strong reported quarter, but the evidence does not yet show durable, broad-based growth.
key_points: Earnings metrics match model; no forecast means no measured beat.
Water-demand mix and durability are unclear; development revenue adds execution exposure.
Cash declined materially; timing and rental thesis checks remain unresolved.
assumptions: Treat the listed model values as existing estimates, not a post-print forecast.
Do not infer recurring water demand or cash-flow implications from the supplied figures.
